title: Answer from the acquirer's test sheet

cases.says: a row naming a card answers that card with the row's response code
a purchase inside a row's amount range, closed or open below, gets that row's response code; a row for another MTI does not apply, and a purchase no row covers is not answered
a row whose rc is -- sends nothing but reports the request as handled
when several rows apply, the one listed first answers, even when a later row is more specific
an amount equal to either end of a row's range belongs to that row, and a range whose two ends are equal holds that one amount
the sheet's amounts are converted to minor units exactly, with no floating-point rounding
a blank upper bound leaves the range open above
a row with an amount not written with two decimals in either bound, an empty range, or a missing or malformed response code stops the sheet from loading

origin.section: 16.1 A Simulator's Rules Are Data, and the First Rule That Matches Decides
